description: Read the extracted plain text of one archived page capture held by Arquivo.pt, the Portuguese web archive — the page content with HTML stripped, as the archive indexed it. Takes the original URL and the capture timestamp (YYYYMMDDhhmmss) that arquivo_search_pages or arquivo_url_history returned, and returns the text (optionally truncated to max_chars) with the archived replay URL. Use it to quote or summarise what a Portuguese page said on a given date without fetching the archived HTML.

max_chars.description: Truncate the text to this many characters (default 20000, max 200000).

timestamp.description: Capture timestamp as YYYYMMDDhhmmss, e.g. "20120121210152" (the captured_at_ts of a hit).

url.description: The original URL exactly as returned in original_url, e.g. "http://www.appia.pt/".

name: arquivo_page_text
title: Arquivo Page Text
